title: Jarrusatula, ahdin ja alipaineyksikkö
subtitle: Appendix 1 — the car parts vocabulary the main course skipped

blocks.text: Forty lessons taught you every grammar pattern in this corpus, but a few specific car parts only ever appeared once or twice and never got their own spotlight — jarrusatula, ahdin, alipaineyksikkö, termostaatti. You already know how to bend these words through any case; this lesson just makes sure you actually recognise them on sight.

blocks.content: {Jarru|word|noun|brake} is the base word for 'brake'. {Jarrusatula|word|compound noun|brake caliper} is jarru + satula (saddle) — the part that clamps the brake pads. {Jarrupala|word|compound noun|brake pad} is jarru + pala (piece). {Puslat|word|noun, plural|bushings} are rubber suspension bushings, and {tukivarsi|word|compound noun|control arm} (plural tukivarret) and {pallonivel|word|compound noun|ball joint} are the suspension parts named in the katsastus overcharging story from Lesson 39.

items.fi: Vaihdettiin {jarrusatula|word|compound noun|brake caliper}, jota ei olisi tarvinnut uusia.
items.en: A brake caliper was changed, which wouldn't have needed renewing.

items.fi: {Jarrupalat|word|compound noun, plural|brake pads} olisi pitänyt vain puhdistaa.
items.en: The brake pads should have just been cleaned.
The rear bushings were in need of replacement.

blocks.content: {Moottori|word|noun|engine} is 'engine', appearing throughout the corpus's most serious complaints. {Termostaatti|word|noun|thermostat} regulates engine temperature. {Ahdin|word|noun|turbocharger} is the turbo unit — its related part {alipaineyksikkö|word|compound noun|vacuum unit} (alipaine, low pressure/vacuum + yksikkö, unit) controls it. {Laturi|word|noun|alternator} charges the battery. {Tulppa|word|noun|spark plug} you already own from Lesson 10 and 21.

items.en: The engine had been permanently damaged.

items.fi: {Ahdin|word|noun|turbocharger} on rikki {alipainekellosta|grammar|elative, compound|from the vacuum valve}.
items.en: The turbocharger is broken at the vacuum valve.

blocks.content: {Rengas|word|noun|tire} (plural renkaat) appears in several short, positive reviews about tire-patching. {Kiristin|word|noun|clamp} is a small fastening clamp — the part left too loose in Lesson 30's winter-breakdown story. {Ohjainrulla|word|compound noun|idler/tensioner pulley} is a belt-guiding pulley, usually mentioned alongside laturi.

items.fi: {Rengasta|grammar|partitive of rengas|the tire} ei voinut paikata, joten piti vaihtaa.
items.en: The tire couldn't be patched, so it had to be changed.
The clamp had been left loose.
It would be worth changing the tensioner pulley too.

blocks.title: Paul Noble Rule
blocks.text: None of these words need new grammar — you already know how to put any of them into the genitive, partitive, or any local case from Lessons 7-19. This lesson is pure vocabulary: once the word itself is familiar, every ending you've learned slots on exactly as it did for korjaamo or osa.

blocks.content: Jarrusatula: YAR-ru-sa-tu-la (five syllables, 'j' as 'y'). Ahdin: AH-din (two syllables, clear 'h'). Alipaineyksikkö: A-li-pai-ne-yk-sik-kö (long compound — break it at the seams: ali-paine-yksikkö).

items: the full set of brake and suspension parts named across the corpus's complaint reviews

rengas, kiristin, ohjainrulla — the remaining small-parts vocabulary
